description: California water year (Oct 1 of prior calendar year through Sep 30). The unit of observation; one row per water year.
Outcome. Total statewide water-year precipitation, inches. Built by src/data/make_ca_wateryear_precip.R.
Primary X. Oceanic Nino Index averaged over Dec-Feb of the water year, from NOAA CPC. Positive = El Nino.
Previous water year oni_djf. Used in Model 3; NA for WY1950 (no prior year in sample).
Alternative X. Nov-Mar Southern Oscillation Index multiplied by -1 so positive = El Nino. NA for WY1950-1951 (CPC SOI starts 1951).
ENSO phase from oni_djf using NOAA cutoffs: El Nino if >= 0.5, La Nina if <= -0.5, else Neutral.

range_or_levels: La Nina; Neutral; El Nino (NA for WY1950-1951)
description: Second, independent phase classification: the same +/-0.5 rule applied to rsoi (atmosphere) rather than oni_djf (ocean).
Intensity bin from |oni_djf|: neutral <0.5, weak <1.0, moderate <1.5, strong <2.0, very_strong >=2.0.
Indicator equal to 1 when enso_phase is El Nino. Model 2 predictor.
Indicator equal to 1 when enso_phase is La Nina. Model 2 predictor.
Linear time trend, 0 at WY1950. Model 3 control for secular drift.
Number of GHCN stations contributing a complete 12-month record that water year (fallback source only).
Provenance flag naming the precipitation source actually used, so a reader can tell the official statewide series from the station composite.
GHCN-Daily station identifier (e.g., USC00040029); joins to ca_station_list.csv.
Calendar month of observation, stored as the first day of the month.
Total monthly precipitation summed from GHCN-Daily station records.
Number of days in the month with a reported observation; months with fewer than 25 reporting days were dropped upstream.
California region the stations were aggregated into: NorCal or SoCal.
Calendar month of observation, stored as the first day of the month.
Mean monthly precipitation across reporting stations in the region.
Number of stations contributing to the regional mean that month; early years rely on very few stations.
NOAA Oceanic Nino Index (3-month running SST anomaly, Nino 3.4 region); NA before the ONI record begins in 1950.
Calendar month number, extracted from ym for seasonal modeling.
ENSO phase classification derived from ONI: ElNino, LaNina, or Neutral (Neutral where ONI is unavailable).
GHCN-Daily station identifier; primary key, joins to ca_monthly_rainfall.csv.
Station latitude (WGS84).
Station longitude (WGS84); negative values are west of the prime meridian.
GHCN element code; PRCP for all rows (precipitation stations only).
First year of precipitation records at the station.
Most recent year of precipitation records at the station.
US state code; CA for all rows.

range_or_levels: 284 unique values (e.g., ADIN RS; ALPINE; ALTADENA)
description: Station name as listed in GHCN-Daily metadata.
Station elevation above sea level; negative values are below sea level.
Water year label (Oct 1 of prior year through Sep 30), WY 1950-2025.
Total California statewide water-year precipitation from NOAA Climate at a Glance (12-month totals ending September). The report's outcome variable (precip_in).
Water year label, WY 1950-2025; merge key to the annual precipitation file.
Oceanic Nino Index: Dec-Feb average SST anomaly in the Nino 3.4 region (NOAA CPC via rsoi::download_oni()). Primary ENSO intensity measure (Models 1, 3, 4).
NOAA ENSO phase for the water year based on winter ONI: el_nino (ONI >= 0.5), la_nina (ONI <= -0.5), or neutral.
ONI-based intensity category: neutral, weak, moderate, strong, or very_strong; used for visualization, not as a model predictor.
Dummy equal to 1 in El Nino water years (Model 2 predictor).
Dummy equal to 1 in La Nina water years (Model 2 predictor).
Previous winter's ONI (one-year lag); NA for WY1950, the first sample year (Model 3 predictor).
Linear time index, 0 for WY1950 through 75 for WY2025 (Model 3 trend control).
